- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout containing real-time desktop transparency test indicators and display troubleshooting steps. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not displaying on desktop after launch, and the waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s with 18.7% drop-off.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Account Ownership Safety Sign-In Placement: Move sign-in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate generation so pet data is immediately linked before desktop launch. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account later.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Pre-Check & Quality Flow: Introduce a photo validation step during pet adoption to give real-time feedback on lighting and resolution before processing. (why: Support logged 3 issues with custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong, contributing to 60.9% adoption step conversion.)
3: [adoption, copy] Photo Quality Guidelines Copy: Update copy across upload_photos and pick_friend to specify exact photo lighting, background, and face framing tips. (why: Reduces custom pet rendering failures and misbehaviors (3 support emails).)
4: [home, wait_info] Background Waiting Time & Notification Option: Add explicit system notification toggle and countdown timer on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app safely during pet creation. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s (nearly 39 minutes), indicating users idle or get lost waiting.)

scores.note: Home step has 18.7% drop-off and high mean wait duration (2336s); redesign requires new layout and release.
8 support emails strongly point to account reset issue; moving sign-in after value creation is a proven UX pattern.
Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (39.1%); adding a pre-check flow addresses rendering failures but requires new screens.
Targets low adoption conversion (60.9%) via text updates; low-cost config/copy change with modest expected lift.
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) by allowing notification-backed backgrounding; requires moderate UI additions.
